mapper.sql: select agent_id, agent_code, agent_name, exec_mode, target_mode, sample_rate, daily_cost_budget, daily_token_budget, paused, pause_reason, paused_by, paused_time, resume_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from abr_growth_agent
mapper.update: update abr_growth_agent set exec_mode = #{execMode}, sample_rate = coalesce(#{sampleRate}, 0), daily_cost_budget = #{dailyCostBudget}, daily_token_budget = #{dailyTokenBudget}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where agent_code = #{agentCode}

update abr_growth_agent set paused = 'Y', pause_reason = #{reason}, paused_by = #{pausedBy}, paused_time = now(), update_by = #{pausedBy}, update_time = now() where agent_code = #{agentCode} and paused = 'N'
update abr_growth_agent set paused = 'N', resume_time = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where agent_code = #{agentCode} and paused = 'Y'
mapper.select: select agent_code as "agentCode", coalesce(sum(cost), 0) as "cost", coalesce(sum(coalesce(prompt_tokens, 0) + coalesce(completion_tokens, 0)), 0) as "tokens" from abr_ai_call_log where create_time >= #{since} and coalesce(biz_type, '') not in ('trial', 'eval') and agent_code = #{agentCode} group by agent_code
